130140101.text: Look. She's sitting over there... and surrounded by monsters!

130140201.text: She seems to be in the same condition as Ilman earlier.

130140202.text: Yes, but luckily, she hasn't been injured or jolted awake yet. Let's carefully move her somewhere safer.

130140204.text: Hmm... Huh? Wh—Why am I back here again?

130140207.text: Dreaming? But what about Professor Aisha...?

130140208.text: Oh, I see. It was all just a dream... Well, that makes sense. After all, it hasn't changed a single bit.

130140210.text: Nearly twenty years, and it still hasn't bloomed... *sigh*

130140211.text: Does it have something to do with your dream? Please, tell us what you mean.

130140212.text: Ah, sorry, I'm still feeling a little groggy. Please give me a moment here... Whew.

130140213.text: Ahem, alright, where to start... Right, this plant... So, Professor Aisha gave me this plant just before she left.

130140214.text: She was a good friend of my parents' and my first real tutor. She was also an outstanding Amurta researcher.

130140215.text: In addition to her extraordinary academic talents, she was also skilled in combat, and would accept lots of work from the Adventurers' Guild.

130140216.text: Oh, so you mean she's left on an adventure?

130140217.text: Yes. When I was about ten years old, she told me that she must go look for the secrets of "the Abyss," and that she would be gone for a long time.

130140218.text: I grabbed hold of her and wouldn't let go. I didn't know what "the Abyss" was... I just knew that she was like family to me.

130140219.text: She hugged me, and we cried for some time until I fell asleep. When I woke up, I was already back home.

130140220.text: She still decided to leave, but had left behind a letter for me saying that I was the person she cared for most in this world.

130140221.text: She claimed that investigating "the Abyss" could help more ordinary people protect the people and things they care about.

130140222.text: She had obtained some important evidence during her past adventures... If she didn't set off right away, she might miss the perfect opportunity.

130140223.text: Guess "ad astra abyssosque" isn't just a slogan...

130140224.text: She left a seed in the letter, telling me that if it sprouted and bloomed, then she'd come back, no matter what sort of risky situation she was in.

130140225.text: She said she looked forward to seeing me all grown up...

130140226.text: But strangely, I've tried watering it, feeding it, everything I could think of... but I've never been able to get it to bloom.

130140227.text: I even went to ask the Amurta researchers, and they couldn't explain it, either.

130140228.text: May I have a look at the plant?

130140229.text: Of course. I was hoping the great Dendro Archon could help me solve this problem.

130140232.text: Huh, we've never seen that look on Nahida's face before.

subQuests.subQuestName: Return to "A Moment of Dreams" again

130140302.text: Uh, I am so sorry, great Dendro Archon. We're still trying to figure out how to explain the whole thing to everyone.

130140303.text: Because of your warning, we've brought dreamers here even if they were completely unaware of the danger.

130140304.text: But some of them have already fallen asleep, and they haven't woken up for a long time. I fear there's nothing we can do about it.

130140305.text: "A Moment of Dreams" is just a small interest group... We don't have enough staff members to handle this.

130140306.text: Just as I expected, it seems my guess was correct.

130140307.text: It's the Dendro Archon. She's back!

130140308.text: What happened? Why have we been gathered here?

130140309.text: Many of you here have been experiencing some beautiful dreams.

130140310.text: But I'm sorry to tell you that based on our investigation, there's some kind of conspiracy behind them.

130140311.text: Before we learn the truth, please don't try to recreate the scenes in your dreams. Whatever you see, don't be tempted by them.

130140313.text: I don't think it's a big deal. Aren't we just dreaming? It's not like dreams will have an effect on others.

130140314.text: We've already met two people who ran off to the countryside alone and got caught in dangerous situations by falling to the temptations in their dreams.

130140315.text: That's right! These aren't just dreams — it's serious!

130140316.text: All right... I get it, I get it.

130140317.text: So does that mean once we have some conclusive results from the investigation, we can continue to enjoy these dreams?

130140318.text: Yeah, I still want to visit my sister in my dreams...

130140321.text: I'm sorry if what I'm about to say sounds a little offensive, great Dendro Archon, but...

130140322.text: We had a discussion with the folks who just arrived here... In all of our dreams, we were able to reunite with people who were very close to us.

130140323.text: They all seemed as if they were alive again, which makes us reluctant to wake up.

130140324.text: Yes, that's also what we've observed in our investigation.

130140325.text: So, if the results of this investigation would mean an end to those dreams, that'd be quite cruel to us.

130140326.text: All of us understand the danger, but... perhaps you can't quite understand just how much those people mean to us.

130140327.text: I don't think everyone will be on board with the plan to abandon these dreams for good.

130140328.text: Before the conclusion of the investigation, they'll at least want to meet the people in their dreams one last time and say goodbye.

130140329.text: We've never had such a difficult situation before. It appears that not many people are willing to cooperate.

130140330.text: So they still want to return to their dreams despite knowing the danger?

subQuests.subQuestName: Follow Pedrush to check on the person who is currently dreaming

130142301.text: Actually, I can really sympathize with everyone's feelings on this.

130141601.text: Hmm, she's only asleep and hasn't started sleepwalking... It seems she hasn't sunk too deep into her dream yet.

130141602.text: Do we also need to fall asleep if we want to go into her dream?

130141603.text: Don't worry about that. I'm Lesser Lord Kusanali, after all.

130141604.text: Now, don't be nervous. Just close your eyes... imagine yourselves as waves gradually rolling onto the beach.

130141605.text: You slowly wash over the shore and sink into the sand...

130140501.text: Hey, this place looks familiar! Isn't it Puspa Café?

130140502.text: Oh, Paimon sees Debbi. She's right over there! Looks like we've come to the right place.

130140503.text: These alluring dreams often portray a scene from real life, which concurs with our previous findings.

130140504.text: Really? But what about that space we were in just now?

130140507.text: You can't mean... this is another collective dream!?

130140508.text: Yes, given that so many people have been experiencing these beautiful dreams, I would say it's very likely that they're interconnected.

130140509.text: Compared to an interconnected dream, independent individual dreams would be much harder to manage and manipulate.

130140510.text: Ah, Paimon gets it now... Well, let's go talk with Debbi.

130140511.text: Oh, but there are some other people next to her. Are they dreaming, too?

130140512.text: If this space is exclusive to Debbi's dream, then the others beside her are most likely the people she cherishes.

130140513.text: Anyway, we should confirm that first, just to be sure.

130140514.text: Huh? How do we do that?

subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to Nahida to understand the situation

130140401.text: What's wrong, Traveler? You look a little disoriented.

130140403.text: Oh, okay. Just remember that Paimon is always here for you!

130140406.text: Anyway, seems like we've made it into the dream!

130140407.text: Hmm, I thought we would arrive at some familiar scene, but we seem to have landed in a completely unfamiliar place.

130140408.text: Whoa, so many giant plants, even in the sky. Amazing...

130140409.text: Theoretically, we should have gone straight into Debbi's dream. Things do seem to have gone a bit sideways here...

130140410.text: Anyway, let's see if we can find any leads.

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the depths of the dream

130140701.text: You know, I've heard that plants grow better if you play music for them.

130140702.text: And on that note, it's been a while since I last heard you play.

130140703.text: Sorry, I've been a little busy these last couple days.

130140704.text: Oh, the Dendro Archon... What a pleasant surprise!

130140705.text: Hmm? Oh! Welcome, great Dendro Archon! And your companions, too, welcome!

130140706.text: I'm Emira. I run the flower shop here. And this is my husband, Moseis.

130140707.text: Yes, how may we help you?

130140708.text: You already know all about me. There's no need for all the pleasantries.

130140709.text: Perhaps I should call you, "the dream's owner"?

130140710.text: Hahaha, as expected of the Dendro Archon.

130140711.text: I'm sorry, Emira. It seems my research has attracted the Dendro Archon's attention.

130140712.text: Why don't you go back to the flower shop, I'll come help you a little later.

130140713.text: Okay, of course, dear. I'll see you later.

130140714.text: It appears that I was too naive to think I could deceive the Dendro Archon in person like this.

130140715.text: To avoid looking like too much of a fool, allow me to ask the first question: How well would you say you understand this dream?

130140716.text: This dream was built by the Akasha, and it has the power to create imaginary people who no longer exist in the real world.

130140717.text: As for you... you've found a unique way to become the owner of this dream, going so far as to have even given up the ability to wake up again.

130140718.text: Given up... the ability to wake up?

130140719.text: Hahaha, impressive! You truly are the embodiment of wisdom.

130140720.text: Please, tell me how you were able to arrive at such a conclusion. In return, I'll answer the question you're most curious about.

130140721.text: It's simple. Apart from you, this space only consists of real people who are dreaming and imaginary people who were created here.

130140722.text: Although you are here and appear no different from the others, I can't sense your dream.

130140723.text: How can I wake up a person who's already awake?

130140725.text: Since you're the fully awake owner of this dream, it can never collapse from you waking up.

130140726.text: Theoretically, this should also give you absolute control over this place. I have to admit, it really doesn't get much better than that.

130140727.text: But even knowing all of that, one question remains: How did you do it?

130140728.text: Isn't the answer right in front of you, great Dendro Archon? It's because I've dedicated my entire reality to this dream.

130140729.text: I uploaded my entire consciousness into the Akasha when it was still running.

130140732.text: Actually, this all started because of an accident. My original goal was not about the Akasha or a collective dream...

130140733.text: No, you were motivated above all to create a hyper-realistic "person"... The desire to reconnect with a "real" loved one is the one shared sentiment between all our dreamers.

130140734.text: That's right. However, human models are too complicated. Only the Akasha has a Jnana Energy supply powerful enough for me to generate and sustain my models.

130140735.text: The Akasha is truly magnificent. If I siphoned a minuscule amount of its energy, nobody would even notice. And even this "minuscule" amount of energy was already more than enough for my purposes.

130140736.text: Even using just crude methods, I was still able to train a fairly realistic person.

130140738.text: Huh? You mean the girl we just saw!?

130140739.text: She and I entered the Akademiya on the same day. Starting with admission procedures, we bumped into each other six times on just that first day.

130140740.text: And because of that one day, we eventually went on to fall in love. We studied, conducted research, and made breakthroughs together.

130140741.text: Our rhythm was always in step. I felt like we were two separate bodies that shared the same heart...

130140742.text: However, Eleazar later took her from me.

130140743.text: So you're gathering others like you.

130140744.text: Yes, I need more training samples to perfect Emira's personality.

130140745.text: I found their details in the Akasha's database. Using the pretext of testing for mental health disorders, I implanted signaling devices in their bodies.

130140746.text: This way, I could connect them to a network, and Emira could feel their yearning. Little by little, they helped her to grow and develop a warm, human personality.

130140747.text: To improve my efficiency and allow myself to focus on nothing but my research, I uploaded my consciousness as well, and became a part of the network.

130140748.text: Hmm, so technically speaking, it's not that you won't wake up — it's that you can't wake up.

130140749.text: Yes. Because the Akasha was suddenly turned off, I lost all of my Jnana Energy. I became imprisoned in the very network I had constructed.

130140750.text: At first, I panicked. But, after coming to grips with the situation, I realized that I could restart this world as long as I could find a replacement source of Jnana Energy.

130140751.text: That means... everyone in the network is providing you with Jnana Energy!

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for clues in the café

130140903.text: He's not very proficient in using the Akasha's technology, and he spent a lot of Jnana Energy creating monsters. Now the system is out of control.

130140904.text: All the people he created also turned into monsters, including Emira.

130140905.text: It's terrible, even for a dream.

130140906.text: Even Paimon's freaked out. Paimon can't imagine what they're going through.

130140908.text: The good news is that the chaos seems to have subsided.

130140909.text: Now we only need to wake up the people here, and let them return to their real lives.

130140911.text: They're all gone. It was just a big dream after all.

130140912.text: I couldn't change my fate, and my knowledge turned out to be useless. What a cruel world...

130140913.text: Do you still think this is our fault?

130140914.text: I don't care about that anymore.

130140915.text: The Jnana Energy used to sustain this dream has all been transformed into monsters. This dream will soon collapse, and my consciousness along with it.

130140916.text: Let me disappear with Emira... I'd rather turn into dust than to ever wake up again.

130140917.text: It seems that everything that's happened is too much for him. He's lost all hope.

130140920.text: I think seeing Emira turn into a monster was punishment enough for him.

130140921.text: After comprehending the hollowness of the unreal, it's time to revisit the meaning of existence.

130140922.text: Existence? Heh, I'm different from the others. I've long given up everything outside of my consciousness.

130140923.text: Using my knowledge of the Akasha, I have a way to extract your consciousness from here and put it inside a knowledge capsule.

130140924.text: The Akademiya has probably kept your body, so you should be able to wake up soon.

130140925.text: No need... Just let me disappear. Reality means nothing to me now.

130140926.text: This isn't compassion. I won't let you escape your punishment by simply disappearing.

130140927.text: As for your life after that, it will be up to you how you want to exist.

130140928.text: Alright, Traveler and Paimon. We should go back.

130140929.text: We can finally wrap up this whole thing...

130140932.text: Oh, nothing. Let's tell the people here to gather at "A Moment of Dreams" after they wake up.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for clues in the café

130142504.text: I've confirmed that this dream belongs only to Debbi. Because, I'm unable to hear the thoughts of the other two people with her.

130142505.text: So, this is the power of the Dendro Archon...?

130142506.text: Paimon had better watch her thoughts from now on.

130142507.text: Hehe, don't worry. I don't often use my powers like this... It's rather impolite.

130142508.text: Alright, I need to get myself ready... It won't be easy to break it to her, but there's no avoiding it now.

130142509.text: Th—The great Dendro Archon! Uh, what brings you here?

130142510.text: I'm sorry to interrupt your celebration, but... have you noticed that what's happening here doesn't quite match up with your memories?

130142511.text: I—I don't quite understand, great Dendro Archon... What do you mean?

130142512.text: I get it. The Dendro Archon is trying to say that it's a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity that we're able to gather here.

130142513.text: Hey, how about a cup of coffee for all of you, my treat! We just returned from a fruitful adventure.

130142515.text: Think carefully. You of all people should know what really happened to them.

130142516.text: Are you sure that meeting here and chatting the day away like this isn't just a product of your own wishful thinking?

130142518.text: Yes, the reports from "The Steambird" were true... The ship they were on struck a reef and sank.

130142519.text: And I never heard from Basimah and Gaspar again...

130142520.text: Hey, c'mon now. What're you talking about, Debbi?

130142521.text: Yeah, trust your memories... Nothing you see here is real.

130142522.text: I get it now. This is a dream, isn't it?

130142523.text: But since it's my dream, it doesn't matter if this is real or not. I enjoy the way things are here... I no longer have to face the tragedies of real life.

130142524.text: These friends mean the world to me. Nobody else can understand me like they do.

130142525.text: There's nothing wrong with continuing this dream, is there?

130142526.text: I'm worried that if you were to continue dreaming like this, the lines between dreams and reality will gradually become too blurred for you.

130142527.text: These dreams will always give you what you want, while reality remains full of pain and difficult situations... If you're not careful, you can get hurt.

130142528.text: Don't worry, I still have control. I won't let it go that far.

130142530.text: Hey, how about we put all this troublesome stuff aside and get back to our coffee and snacks, hmm?

130142531.text: Whether it's just a dream or real life, you should be happy.

130142532.text: You can't just brush off something like this! We don't even know how you people got here, or where you even came from...

130142535.text: Ah, sorry! Paimon didn't mean to upset anyone.

130142536.text: No, it's alright. I understand that you're just trying to look out for me.

130142537.text: It seems that for now, this place is still relatively harmless for you.

130142538.text: But I wonder if there's any way to go deeper into the dream...

130142539.text: Huh, now that you mention it, I once heard a strange voice tell me that there's an entrance here.

130142540.text: I'm not interested in checking it out at the moment, but maybe I'll go in and have a look later.

130142542.text: Just as I expected, we're only on the surface of this dream. Let's go.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the deeper part of the dream

130141201.text: Huh? What are we doing here again?

130141202.text: Wait a second!? We were just up there, no... down there... Uh, did we go up or down?

130141203.text: Don't panic, this is how dreams work.

130141204.text: We've left Debbi's dream, but the dream is still continuing onward. I'm not sure where it'll lead us.

130141205.text: This dream has the ability to create imaginary people, which is why people are so unwilling to wake up.

130141206.text: If it weren't for what we just saw, Paimon might still find that a bit hard to believe...

130141207.text: So what awaits us further in the dream?

130141208.text: I have a guess. If these dreams are connected, then there should be some sort of order to them.

130141209.text: The fact that Debbi was able to realize that she was dreaming means that she is not very deep in the dream yet.

130141210.text: But the space we're in has been turned upside down. Do you remember the characteristics of dreams that I mentioned earlier?

130141212.text: That's right. It's possible that we're heading deeper into this dream now, and the deeper we go, the closer we'll get to the essence of the dream.

130141213.text: Right, so the answers might be waiting for us deeper in the dream.

130141215.text: Yes, and we should get ready for whatever we may encounter.

130141001.text: The coffee here still tastes the same as ever, haha.

130141002.text: You two have traveled all around Teyvat. Surely, you've all tasted better coffee than this.

130141003.text: I suppose so, but no matter how good things may be elsewhere, nothing beats the taste of home.

130141004.text: That's right! It's hard to change your tastes.

130141005.text: Anyway, here's to your return home! Welcome back, everyone!

130140601.text: Wait, weren't we already here a little earlier?

130140603.text: Huh? Why would he start dreaming again?

130140605.text: Yes, but it seems that the danger isn't enough to stop him from longing for his wife.

130140606.text: Based on what we've learned so far, he must be sleeping more deeply for his dream to appear here.

130140607.text: But fortunately, he already knows us from before, so hopefully we'll be able to wake him up.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for clues near the cliff

130141102.text: Oh, it's you! Incredible, I didn't know you would appear in my dream too.

130141103.text: Did you say dream? Wait, so you know this is a dream!?

130141104.text: Of course, such good things rarely happen to me in real life these days.

130141105.text: Here, let me introduce everyone. This is Maynar, my wife who I mentioned before, and this is our daughter, Haydar.

130141106.text: Hello, it's a great honor to meet the Dendro Archon.

130141107.text: Whoa, Dad, you know the Dendro Archon!? That's amazing!

130141108.text: And what's this? *gasp* Is it a new toy!?

130141109.text: No, it's Paimon! Not a toy!

130141110.text: Anyway, now's not the time for that! Nahida, this doesn't seem to add up with what we were expecting.

130141111.text: Hmm, you're right. Let me think for a bit here...

130141114.text: Oh, right! We didn't see him in "A Moment of Dreams" earlier. Paimon thought he'd gone home!

130141115.text: Sorry, I just had to make sure that Haydar could get a chance to see her mother.

130141116.text: I had gotten pretty familiar with the hike, so I brought Haydar with me. I'm just glad we didn't meet any monsters along the way.

130141117.text: Yes, I'm glad too. I didn't expect her to grow up so fast.

130141118.text: It must have been very hard for him. I regret not being able to fulfill my role as a wife and a mother.

130141119.text: No, don't talk like that. Let's leave all that unhappy stuff behind for now. Even if we're in a dream, it's still a blessing that we've been able to reunite in this way.

130141120.text: What should we do now? Should we... tell him the truth?

130141121.text: You can... You can let me break the news. I should... be the one to do it.

130141122.text: I'm sorry, but I should tell you that your dream did not create us. We are real people with our own consciousness.

130141123.text: Like the last time we met, we're still investigating this dream, and we've already learned some things about it.

130141124.text: So you mean, there's something nefarious with this dream as well?

130141126.text: It seems the reunion of our family is destined to only be temporary.

130141128.text: Maybe... But in all likelihood, that is indeed how things will end.

130141131.text: I'm afraid I don't quite understand what's going on...

130141132.text: Don't worry, Haydar. Mom's not going anywhere. Please don't cry.

130141133.text: Maynar doesn't understand any of this.

130141134.text: I'm fully aware that this is a dream, so that's why I've never told her the truth, but...

130141135.text: Never mind. It's not like I would know what to say...

130141136.text: I mean, I don't get any of the complicated stuff, but regardless of whether this dream is good or bad, you're here to resolve it, right?

130141138.text: Then please, let us enjoy this moment for just a while longer.

130141139.text: Regardless of whatever caused this dream to come to pass, I feel extremely grateful to have had the chance to reunite with my family.

130141140.text: But, does this dream... really have to disappear?

130141144.text: Please, come this way. You can go even deeper into the dream by heading in this direction.

130141145.text: I have heard that the further down you go, the more pleasant the dreams become... and the more you want to stay.

130141146.text: The answer you're looking for may also be found there. Go ahead.

130141147.text: Thank you for helping us, and I'm truly sorry.

130141148.text: You're welcome. It's not like I have any say in the matter. I'm just an ordinary person, after all. Who am I to interfere with the work of a god?

130141149.text: I'll be right behind you. I should at least let Maynar and Haydar know what's going on here.

130141150.text: Otherwise, my daughter might be mad at her mother after we wake up...

130141301.text: It's the same place again... This place is almost like a flight of stairs that connects all the dreams together!

130141302.text: But they appear to be getting more and more aggressive. Regular stairs wouldn't try to attack us.

130141303.text: Let's recap what we've learned so far.

130141304.text: Right, something seems to be off about our theory.

130141305.text: Ilman is clearly aware that he's dreaming, and he's enjoying it.

130141306.text: Rather than dreaming on a deeper level, he almost seemed... more awake?

130141307.text: I believe we're on the right track, but we just need another explanation.

130141308.text: It's not that the dreams are getting deeper, it's the owners' attachment to the dreams that's getting stronger.

130141309.text: But you would never mistake dreams for real life, right?

130141312.text: Sometimes, Paimon almost wishes her dreams could be real!

130141313.text: But it's just a quick thought... It's not long before Paimon's thinking about other things... like Sticky Honey Roast.

130141314.text: Listen, we're real beings living in the real world, and that's where our focus should be.

130141315.text: This also explains the insubstantiality of our dreams. No matter what they may become, we don't really care.

130141316.text: But if we decide to abandon reality and embrace our dreams, then our dreams would become far more substantial.

130141317.text: Oh! Wait, Paimon's starting to get it now!

130141318.text: Your mind will begin to build the dream far more attentively, which in turn will make it feel more real.

130141319.text: Do you remember how the Akasha can turn dreams into Jnana Energy?

130141320.text: Constructing a realistic dream consumes a similar energy.

subQuests.subQuestName: Reach the deepest part of the dream

130141402.text: Uh, well, it's just new to Paimon in this dream...

130141403.text: This should be the final destination.

130141405.text: It's more ordinary than I imagined.

130141406.text: Yeah, these are just ordinary city streets.

130141407.text: I have powers related to dreams, so it's usually easy for me to tell who's dreaming and who's created by dreams.

130141408.text: I guess only those who have thoroughly accepted this dream will be able to come here.

130141409.text: There are so many people here. How can we find the host?

130141410.text: Don't worry. I have a way.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for clues in the city

130141501.text: That's all there really is to it. I don't think I'm doing anything wrong — I'm just saving them as well as myself.

130141502.text: I provide a beautiful dream, and in return, I harvest their Jnana Energy as fuel for the dream.

130141503.text: They can wake up anytime they wish. People need to sleep anyway, so why not have some beautiful dreams while they rest?

130141504.text: I agree. This is the home we spent a great deal of effort on to build for ourselves.

130141505.text: Yeah, she's right. We are staying here of our own free will.

130141506.text: I don't understand this at all, but I just want to spend some more time with my family. I don't want them to be sad.

130141507.text: ...Thank you, dear. Great Dendro Archon, I hope you can understand.

130141508.text: You don't need to gather around here. It's alright.

130141509.text: The great Dendro Archon is nothing if not kind and considerate towards her people. She won't interfere with what we're doing here.

130141510.text: Uh oh, now he's playing dirty...

130141513.text: It seems like I won't need you to answer my last question.

130141514.text: You're willing to tell me all your secrets because you have nothing to fear.

130141515.text: If you use real people as your weapon and turn them against their archon, then there's nothing the archon can do.

130141516.text: They just want to be with the people they cherish. I don't think there's anything wrong with me providing them with that opportunity.

130141517.text: They don't wish to eternally part with their spouses and friends. What's so wrong about that?

130141518.text: If you understood humans a little better or had also experienced firsthand the absolute devastation of loss, then perhaps you wouldn't be so cold towards us.

subQuests.subQuestName: The dream is out of control

130131101.text: It's just sleepwalking, they're really overreacting.

130131201.text: It's just a dream. How bad could it be?

130131301.text: What's all the sudden commotion about?

130142101.text: Sorry, I might have spoken a little out of turn just now.

130142102.text: I just think that the gods really don't understand us sometimes...

130142201.text: It's hard to talk them into coming here. What's happening is way beyond us.

130142401.text: All this commotion is making me wish I could experience this kind of dream, too.

130142402.text: No way, not on Paimon's watch!

130142403.text: Alright, alright... No need to get so worked up.

130142601.text: I think I need a moment to calm down.

130142602.text: Hey, what's with the sad face?

130142603.text: Yeah, there's no need to worry about all that complicated stuff.

130144101.text: You go right on ahead, I'll catch up with you later.

130144102.text: Cheer up, Dad... And Mommy, too.

130144401.text: It's a bit noisy today, isn't it?

130144402.text: Huh, you think so? I don't feel anything out of the ordinary.

130144403.text: Oh, maybe you're right. It's always been quite peaceful here.

130144501.text: What should I buy? Hey, tell me what you think, Shadiyah.

130144502.text: How about this? I think it would really suit you.

130144503.text: Let me have a look... Oh, it looks great.

130144601.text: Wow, what a beautiful place. Look Mom, the scenery is so pretty here!

130144603.text: Oh, hey! Seems we somehow managed to get here before you.

130144604.text: Huh? How did you beat us here? Didn't you have to go through that super crazy confusing place?

130144605.text: Uh, I'm not sure what you're talking about... All we did was walk through that passageway, and here we are.

130144606.text: We're in a dream. The concept of fixed spaces doesn't always apply here.

130144701.text: It's not going to rain soon, is it?

130144702.text: Then maybe we should head home? I don't wanna get rained on.

130144703.text: Yeah, let's wait for the weather to get better before we head back out again. It's not like we're in a rush or anything.

130144801.text: Remember to come to the flower shop later. I've got a surprise for you.

130144802.text: Oh, sure thing, Emira. I'll be over as soon as I'm done with this.

130149001.text: Heh, you haven't won just yet

130149901.text: This lady refused to heed our warnings and fell asleep here a little earlier.

130149902.text: (Even if the gods can sense our pain, they can't understand how fragile we truly are.)

130149904.text: (What's so wrong about a beautiful dream?)

130149905.text: (...I can't help but be really curious, though. Just what are these dreams...?)

130149907.text: Huh, a door? Hmm, wonder where it could lead...

130149908.text: It's not like we have any other way to go now. Let's go in and have a look.

130149910.text: Hmm, it looks like we may need to put something inside there...

130149911.text: Huh!? Are we back up here again? Ah wait, Paimon's confused! Are we up here or down there!?

130149912.text: Whew, good thing we didn't fall, hehe...

130149913.text: Yes we did, we just fell upwards.

130149914.text: That's not helping, Nahida! Ugh, Paimon has no clue what's going on anymore!

130149915.text: Whoa, when it rains, it seems to disappear slowly.

130149916.text: Yes, and it appears again as soon as the rain stops. It's less like a flower, and more like a Dendro Slime that's trying to keep out of sight.

130149917.text: Heh, here we go again with Nahida's analogies...

130149918.text: (Is this too cruel for Haydar? How can I ever get her to come to terms with this...?)

130149919.text: We're not doing something bad... are we, Nahida?

130149920.text: That depends on how you define "good" and "bad."

130149921.text: All the water that used to be here has turned into rain.

130149922.text: Then let's get through here before the water level rises.

130149923.text: We've finally made it. The destination is right ahead!

130149924.text: (Anisah is always so calm... I wish I were the same.)

130149925.text: He's just in an ordinary dream, so it shouldn't be him.

130149926.text: (Shadiyah has such good taste. I can never go wrong with her opinion.)

130149927.text: No, it doesn't seem to be her.

130149928.text: (Who doesn't want a dream to last forever...?)

130149929.text: He's just entered the dream recently. It's definitely not him.

130149931.text: (Sometimes I wish Rakesh could be more assertive, but... I guess I'm also happy enough with the way things are.)

130149934.text: All of you, please get out of here and find somewhere safe!

130149935.text: I am the master of this dream. I can create endless waves of monsters with the snap of a finger.

130149936.text: Don't worry. They'll wake up before they get hurt. Emira doesn't like to see others in pain.

130149937.text: If you know what's good for you, leave now.

130149940.text: ■■, what should I do? Where did ■■ go?

130149941.text: ■■■ left because he doesn't want you anymore!

130149943.text: ■■■, get away from there! Don't ruin my flowers!

130149944.text: Who... am I? I'm... not Emira. I'm ■■■.

130149947.text: (So some people are having pretty realistic dreams, big deal. What are they so worried about?)

130149948.text: (What happened? I need to ask someone and find out.)
